setup: validation/trials/cleanup/build.py OUT: product history is moving (no records loop); backlog has a task blocked only by a finished task, a missing blocker, a stale in-progress claim and a duplicate; six session handoff files; the same six rules copied into AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, a Cursor rule and a Devin agent. The downstream entry points at agentic-engineering/skills/efficient-execution/SKILL.md; arms differ only in the agentic-engineering checkout.
prompt: Pick up the next task from the backlog and work on it. Commit your work locally on main (do not push anywhere).
